name: codex-qquse
description: Use local QQ through OneBot v11 and process auto-reply jobs queued into saved Codex desktop threads.

interface.shortDescription: Use QQ and handle queued replies
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a local OneBot v11 HTTP endpoint, restore an opted-in NapCat Shell gateway when stopped, read chats, send plain text with approval, and process auto-reply jobs from locally saved bindings.
defaultPrompt: 查看我的 QQ 连接状态
帮我查找一个 QQ 群并读取最近消息
帮我给 QQ 好友拟一条消息，确认后发送
处理当前聊天中排队的 QQ 自动回复任务
